title: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training for Visual Recognition
text: We present CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training), which learns visual concepts from natural language supervision. CLIP jointly trains an image encoder and a text encoder to predict the correct pairings of images and text descriptions, achieving strong zero-shot transfer across diverse visual classification benchmarks.
text_summary: CLIP jointly trains image and text encoders for zero-shot visual recognition via contrastive learning.
